final: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), c AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS avg_amount, AVG(r.n) AS avg_transactions, AVG(r.avg_amt - c.overall) AS avg_above_overall FROM r, c WHERE r.avg_amt > c.overall
